hints.tr: Salt okunur için sona `:ro`; iki bağlama için iki ayrı `-v`.
hints.en: `:ro` at the end for read-only; two separate `-v` for two mounts.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**commands.sh**

```bash
docker run --rm -v ${PWD}:/app -w /app python:3.13-slim python app.py
docker run --rm -v ${PWD}/config:/config:ro app
docker run --rm -v notes:/data -v ${PWD}:/backup alpine:3.22 `
  tar czf /backup/notes.tgz -C /data .
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**commands.sh**

```bash
docker run --rm -v ${PWD}:/app -w /app python:3.13-slim python app.py
docker run --rm -v ${PWD}/config:/config:ro app
docker run --rm -v notes:/data -v ${PWD}:/backup alpine:3.22 `
  tar czf /backup/notes.tgz -C /data .
```
